_appid: Skip Steam: this is the 2001 PS2 NTSC-U disc (SLUS-20312). The only Steam listing is 'FINAL FANTASY X/X-2 HD Remaster' (appid 359870), a 2016 re-release with remade character models, a re-recorded soundtrack and the International-edition content - a different product whose art and description would misrepresent this dump.
description: Final Fantasy X (PS2 2001 USA, via PCSX2)
long: Final Fantasy X is Square's 2001 PlayStation 2 role-playing game and the first in the series with voice acting and fully 3D environments. Tidus, a star blitzball player pulled a thousand years into the future, joins the summoner Yuna's pilgrimage across Spira to destroy the world-devouring Sin. Combat is the Conditional Turn-Based Battle system, which shows the turn order and lets any party member be swapped in mid-fight, and character growth runs on the Sphere Grid instead of experience levels.
name: Final Fantasy X
short: Tidus is thrown a thousand years into Spira's future and joins the summoner Yuna's pilgrimage to destroy Sin, fighting through turn-order-visible CTB battles and growing his party on the Sphere Grid.
